video_title: LeBron to Warriors if Lakers Resign Austin Reaves?!?

quotes.speaker: Sam Amick
quotes.summary_phrase: Trae Young's potential trade leverage with the Atlanta Hawks
quotes.excerpt: It feels like a little bit of leverage play for me, that Trae wants to make sure
quotes.quote: It feels like a little bit of leverage play for me, that Trae wants to make sure the Wizards take care of him. When he went that direction, it felt like there was already a handshake deal in place. Especially when it seemed like he was healthy enough to play and then he wasn't playing, it added fuel to that fire. You guys know this stuff happens all the time. We need to drop some games this year, get the number one pick, but here is what we got for you on the back end. So I am a little bit surprised that there is as much noise around Trae as there is.

quotes.speaker: Sam Amick
quotes.summary_phrase: Darryn Peterson's push to join the Washington Wizards or Memphis Grizzlies
quotes.excerpt: Darryn is trying to push his way to either Washington or Memphis.
quotes.quote: Darryn is trying to push his way to either Washington or Memphis. It didn't work for Ace, and that's the Jazz's counter. We've literally seen this movie a year ago and guess what, Ace is an important part of our program. That bluff was called. I don't know if it's just a matter of fit in terms of how Darryn sees it or if it's market, but certainly that's what he's trying to pull off here.

quotes.speaker: Sam Amick
quotes.summary_phrase: Draft night predictions for the top three picks
quotes.excerpt: I got DeBonza first. I am going to go with Peterson and say they do the Bailey thing.
quotes.quote: I got DeBonza first. I am going to go with Peterson and say they do the Bailey thing and just push right through it. And then Memphis has been tied to Boozer for a long time. The one thing as a subplot that I did love, and I don't know if I'm reading the room the right way, but when it comes to the Jazz, you had a funny couple days of news where it was like, Peterson doesn't want to work out, that makes the Jazz look bad. Then I wrote the Walker Kessler thing, he's frustrated. Then the story you mentioned, Chandler. What I kind of loved about it in terms of the chessboard and the way the media comes into play here is like, the Jazz immediately getting it out there that they're seriously considering Cam Boozer, to me, felt very much like, hey Walker, look how easy it would be to go get a big who could take your job and be a whole lot cheaper.

quotes.speaker: Sam Amick
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James and Austin Reaves' future with the Los Angeles Lakers
quotes.excerpt: If Austin gets paid in the kind of way that keeps him in town, then there's not enough money for LeBron.
quotes.quote: If Austin gets paid in the kind of way that keeps him in town, then there's not enough money for LeBron to feel respected, and then I could see him going up the coast and maybe doing the Warriors thing. I feel like there's just not enough money to make all those guys happy with the Lakers. They have got to get better, and if they just resign LeBron, resign Austin, resign Rui, that's not getting better, that's maintaining. All of their guys are signaling, I will stay if you don't disrespect me with the number. That's basically what the shared messaging is.

quotes.speaker: Sam Amick
quotes.summary_phrase: Ja Morant's potential landing spots in New Orleans or Sacramento
quotes.excerpt: The only two teams I've heard, and I'll pick one of them, is New Orleans and Sacramento.
quotes.quote: The only two teams I've heard, and I'll pick one of them, is New Orleans and Sacramento. I'll probably push it the New Orleans way.

quotes.speaker: Sam Amick
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Ballmer's reluctance to trade Kawhi Leonard
quotes.excerpt: Steve Ballmer, who as we know runs that whole kingdom, is still acting like he doesn't want to give Kawhi up.
quotes.quote: Steve Ballmer, who as we know runs that whole kingdom, is still acting like he doesn't want to give Kawhi up.

quotes.speaker: Sam Amick
quotes.summary_phrase: Julius Randle's future with the Minnesota Timberwolves
quotes.excerpt: I don't personally think the Timberwolves have a pathway to, I hate to say it, I think they're going to continue swinging and missing.
quotes.quote: I don't personally think the Timberwolves have a pathway to, I hate to say it, I think they're going to continue swinging and missing on big names. So I think Julius stays put.

quotes.speaker: Sam Amick
quotes.summary_phrase: Michael Porter Jr.'s potential return to the Denver Nuggets
quotes.excerpt: He should go back to Denver, try to write that wrong.
quotes.quote: He should go back to Denver, try to write that wrong. They, MPJ, he had a hell of a year.

quotes.speaker: Sam Amick
quotes.summary_phrase: Detroit Pistons' need for aggressive roster moves
quotes.excerpt: Detroit is going to be loud. I think they know they got to make a move.
quotes.quote: Detroit is going to be loud. I think they know they got to make a move because they've been tied to Austin Reaves, they've been tied to a bunch of different guys. They just know that they need some more juice on that roster. So let's do MPJ to Detroit.

quotes.speaker: Sam Amick
quotes.summary_phrase: Anthony Davis's future with the Washington Wizards
quotes.excerpt: I think he's got to make it work in DC.
quotes.quote: I'm keeping him there. It's he's not the name does not match the game anymore. Just doesn't in terms of the market and if you tie it to the contract. I don't see teams giving up too much for him at this point. So I think he's got to make it work in DC.
